text:
Maria: Quick check — refining the benchmark landing: need hero headline, two charts, and CTA split. Aim for clarity for product teams and quick skimmability.

Tess: Charts: (1) Latency ladder (median 0, p95) across models/workloads; (2) Cost per 1k tokens with a quantized overlay. Minimal labels, big numbers only.

Leo: Add a tiny steady-state callout showing batching savings (~35%) so infra folks see econ levers.

Omar: Positioning headline options: "Serve reliably. Optimize spend." or "Fast, predictable inference 1 lower cost per token." I prefer the first, more enterprise-friendly.

DesignBot: Frames uploaded: https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-cta (marketing edit). Suggested overlay color for quantized bars: #00BFA6. Alt text auto-generated.

AnalyticsBot: Mock CSV for designers to work from:
``nmodel,med_ms,p95_ms,cost_fp16,cost_quant
rw-7b,60,220,0.45,0.28
rw-20b,110,340,0.95,0.60
rw-65b,180,520,1.85,1.10
```
Use normalized y-axis on hero if it reads cleaner; appendix must have raw numbers.

Maria: CTA routing: 
- Try Hosted -> landing?utm_campaign=bench_launch_hosted
- Request Dedicated -> landing?utm_campaign=bench_launch_dedicated
- Private Deployment -> landing?utm_campaign=bench_launch_private
Include hidden form field 'company_size' and 'primary_workload'.

Tess: Hero copy (final): "Predictable latency. Predictable spend." Subhead: "Benchmarks from real workloads 1 see appendix for full numbers and methodology."

Leo: Sales slide: show absolute $/1k and latency ms, callout: "quantized = measured on our 8-bit runtime; batching example shows ~35% steady-state savings."

Maria: Actions: Tess -> finalize hero copy and 25-char headline; DesignBot -> export hero PNGs + alt text by EOD; AnalyticsBot -> produce appendix CSV and methodology blurb; Omar -> prep three landing pages and UTMs. Review deck at 10:00 tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
